description: A sprite sheet of NINE separate small bone wasteland props arranged in a 3 by 3 grid, each small and centered in its own cell, in this exact order left to right, top to bottom: giant white beast ribcage half buried in the ground; huge horned white beast skull; small scattered pile of white bones; dead gray tree stump with cracked bark; cluster of pale bleached white rocks; tattered red war banner on a wooden pole; rusty broken sword stuck upright in the ground; wooden barricade of crossed sharpened stakes; wooden totem pole topped with skulls, drawn in straight FRONT VIEW like the reference (facing the camera, slight top-down), thick dark outline, soft cel shading, bleached pale and dusty colors, every object fully separate on a plain flat solid bright magenta (#FF00FF) chroma-key background with wide empty space around it, no ground, no shadow puddles, no text, no numbers, no characters

style_image.usage_description: Copy ONLY the art style of this reference: chunky chibi pixel art, thick dark outline on every shape, soft cel shading, front-facing view, one small object centered in each cell of the 3 by 3 grid. Do not copy these objects or their colors.
